title: Dimensionally engineered MOF films for chemiresistive sensors
content:
Chem. Soc. Rev., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D5CS01049G, Review Article
Wei-Hua Deng, Ke Xiao, Zhibin Cheng, Chu-Long Liu, Shengchang Xiang, Gang Xu
This review summarizes how tailoring metal–organic framework (MOF) films from thick to 2D and 3D architectures enhances sensor sensitivity, speed, and detection limits, providing a roadmap for future sensing technologies.
